April 14 1933
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& E. A. REGISTRY
No. D 4787
Date 20 / 4 / 33

Yakir Shutte

Yakir Shutte, Brazilian citizen, is known as a
former brothel keeper at No.7 Thorne Road. Applied
for a Restaurant licence with liquor on June 14, 1932.
This was turned down in accordance with the Commissioner
of Police memo No.510, dated March 26, 1929. Shutte
was warned that the licence would not meet with the
approval of the Police, yet opened on June 29, 1932 the
premises as the "Portland Cafe" and began selling wines
and spirits. On June 30, 1932 Sergeant Gloobkoff
asked for the licence and Shutte answered "My licence is
the Brazilian Consulate". On the 4th July, 1932 Shutte
was informed by the Police that a summons was applied
against him for breach of Bye-law 34 - opening a restaurant
without a licence. He absolutely defied the Police and
carried on the business without a licence. Yakir Shutte
closed his restaurant at No.504 East Broadway through
trade depression. (A. 32/290.)
Towards the end of March 1933 a gambling and opium smoking
den known as the " Circulo Braziliero " was opened by E.
Sosichner and others at No. 199 Bubbling Well Road and No.
41 Moulmien Road and Yakir Shutte was appointed Secretary.
( C. 6849 )

1933年4月14日
上海公共租界工部局警务处
及东亚登记处
编号 D 4787
日期 1933年4月20日

雅基尔·舒特

雅基尔·舒特，巴西公民，已知曾为索恩路7号的前妓院经营者。于1932年6月14日申请含酒类的餐馆执照。该申请依据1929年3月26日警务处长第510号备忘录予以驳回。舒特受到警告，称其执照不会获得警方批准，但他仍于1932年6月29日将该处所作为“波特兰咖啡馆”（Portland Cafe）开业，并开始销售葡萄酒和烈酒。1932年6月30日，警佐格卢布科夫（Gloobkoff）要求查看执照，舒特回答说：“我的执照就是巴西领事馆。”1932年7月4日，警方通知舒特，因其违反附例第34条——无照开设餐馆，已对其提出传票起诉。他公然蔑视警方，在无照情况下继续经营。雅基尔·舒特因商业萧条关闭了位于百老汇路504号的餐馆。（档案号 A. 32/290。）
1933年3月底，一个名为“巴西俱乐部”（Circulo Braziliero）的赌博及鸦片烟馆由埃·索西克纳（E. Sosichner）等人在静安寺路199号和莫尔缅路41号开设，雅基尔·舒特被任命为秘书。（档案号 C. 6849）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
April 13 B. REGISTER 33
N. D H 787
2014 133

Emanuel Sosichner, Russian Jew by birth,
Brazilian citizen, unrecognized by the
Consulate.

Sossichine or Sossichiner, No.27 Quinsan Gardens
formerly a Russian lawyer, now Brazilian. It is
rumoured that he paid $3,000 to become a Brazilian
citizen. He is closely connected with H. Auslander,
French Protegee, with whom he lives. (Reported by
D.S.I. Hunter on 12.9.25 - File B.2032.) E. Sosichner
derives a considerable income by lending protection of
his name and nationality to foreign gambling houses.
His wife keeps a boarding house, No.25-27 Yoong Allen
Court. (Reported by P.C.S. Kedrolivansky on 16.5.27 -
File B. 2593.) E. Sosichner was connected with
gambling and is reported to have been in charge of
gambling in the "Premier Café" in the French Concession
prior to it being raided in 1928. It was also discovered
that Sosichner was connected with the "Wheel", 151c Bubbling
Well Road to which he gave the protection of his name and
nationality. (Reported by D.S. O'Neill on 25.6.29. -
File I.O. 9762.) Further enquiries reveal the fact
that although recognized in 1923 as a Brazilian subject
E. Sosichner in 1928 was brought before the French Mixed
Court on a charge of gambling. It was definitely learned
at the Brazilian Consulate that Sosichner is not registered
there, so that he may be regarded as an unrecognized subject.
(Reported by D.S. O'Neill on 1.7.29. - File I.O. 9762.)
Towards the end of March 1933 a gambling and opium smoking
den known as the " Circulo Braziliero " was opened by E.
Sosichner at 199 Bubbling Well Road and 41 Moulmien Road. Efforts
were made to obtain a warrant from the Brazilian Consul
General to raid the premises, but was rejected by the Consul
General on the grounds that E. Sosichner was a Brazilian by
birth and an attorney at law and that such a club was allowed
under Brazilian law. ( April 13, 1933- C6849. )

埃马纽埃尔·索西克纳，俄裔犹太人，巴西公民，未获领事馆承认。

索西奇内（Sossichine）或索西奇纳（Sossichiner），昆山路花园27号住户，前俄罗斯律师，现属巴西籍。有传言称他支付了3,000美元以获得巴西公民身份。他与法国受保护人H. 奥斯兰德（H. Auslander）关系密切，并与之同住。（由副督察亨特于1925年9月12日报告 - 档案号 B.2032。）埃·索西克纳通过向外籍赌窟提供其姓名和国籍的庇护而获取丰厚收入。其妻子经营一家寄宿公寓，位于永年里25-27号。（由警长凯德罗利万斯基于1927年5月16日报告 - 档案号 B. 2593。）埃·索西克纳与赌博活动有关联，据报在1928年被搜查之前，他负责法租界“普雷米耶咖啡馆”（Premier Café）内的赌博事务。还发现索西克纳与静安寺路151c号的“轮盘赌馆”（The Wheel）有关联，他向该处提供了其姓名和国籍的庇护。（由巡官奥尼尔于1929年6月25日报告 - 档案号 I.O. 9762。）进一步调查揭示，尽管埃·索西克纳在1923年被承认为巴西臣民，但他于1928年因赌博指控被带上法国混合法庭。从巴西领事馆确切获悉，索西克纳并未在该馆注册，因此可被视为未被承认的臣民。（由巡官奥尼尔于1929年7月1日报告 - 档案号 I.O. 9762。）
1933年3月底，一个名为“巴西俱乐部”（Circulo Braziliero）的赌博及鸦片烟馆由埃·索西克纳在静安寺路199号和莫尔缅路41号开设。当局曾努力从巴西总领事处获取搜查该处所的令状，但被总领事以埃·索西克纳为出生即有的巴西公民且为执业律师，以及此类俱乐部在巴西法律下被允许为由予以拒绝。（1933年4月13日 - 档案号 C6849。）
